themes.title: Far-right parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right movements across North America and Europe are intensifying their focus on strict border management and immigration restrictions. Administrations and parties are pushing measures ranging from visa revocations and asylum limitations to aggressive anti-migrant rhetoric in response to regional border tensions.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Highlighted illegal Channel crossings and proposed restricting social housing access for foreign nationals

countries.note: Campaigned on radical border enforcement and 'remigration' proposals ahead of regional elections
